items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Tommy Miles in the context of other musicians (Fred Norman, Trummy Young, Billy Eckstine) and does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Tommy Miles himself.

ctx.x: : That's amazing. He went on to great heights, writing for a right, with the Broadway shows and --
And Norman -- what's his first name? He was a very good arranger, too. He used to play trombone with Tommy Miles. Wears glasses. You've seen him around. He arranges for the shows he has.
